import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, flow, cost;
        Edge(int to, int capacity, int flow, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 15000;
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static long total_cost = 0;
    static long[] dist = new long[MAXN];
    static int[] p = new int[MAXN], pe = new int[MAXN], inq = new int[MAXN];
    static int s = 9998, t = 9999;
    static int n, m, k, c, d;

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        adj[u].add(edges.size()); edges.add(new Edge(v, cap, 0, cst));
        adj[v].add(edges.size()); edges.add(new Edge(u, 0, 0, -cst));
    }

    static void run() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, 10000, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(p, 0, 10000, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pe, 0, 10000, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0, 10000, 0);
        dist[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        inq[s] = 1;
        int cur = t;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inq[u] = 0;
            for (int e_idx : adj[u]) {
                Edge e = edges.get(e_idx);
                if (e.capacity - e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cst = e.cost, y = e.to;
                if (dist[y] > dist[u] + cst) {
                    dist[y] = dist[u] + cst;
                    p[y] = u;
                    pe[y] = e_idx;
                    if (inq[y] == 0) {
                        inq[y] = 1;
                        q.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int node = cur;
        while (node != s) {
            int e_idx = pe[node];
            edges.get(e_idx).flow++;
            edges.get(e_idx ^ 1).flow--;
            node = p[node];
        }
        total_cost += dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            add_edge(s, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 101; i++) {
            add_edge((i - 1) * n, t, k, (i - 1) * c);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= 100; j++) {
                add_edge(x + (j - 1) * n, y + (j - 1) * n + n, 1, d * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1));
                add_edge(y + (j - 1) * n, x + (j - 1) * n + n, 1, d * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 100; j++) {
                add_edge(i - 1 + (j - 1) * n, i - 1 + (j - 1) * n + n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            run();
        }

        System.out.println(total_cost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
